preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is not greater than 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s if c.isalpha())
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only lowercase English letters and digits, and no spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string s is either a digit or a decimal point.

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) <= 10 and name.isalpha() for name, price in re.findall(r'([a-z]+)(\d+(\.\d{2})?)', s))
preconditions.description: Each purchase name is a non-empty string of length not more than 10 consisting of lowercase English letters, and each price is a non-empty string consisting of digits and dots.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= float(price) <= 10^6 for name, price in re.findall(r'([a-z]+)(\d+(\.\d{2})?)', s))
preconditions.description: Each price is a number not less than one cent and not greater than 10^6 dollars.

postconditions.description: The output is a string representing the total price in the same format as the input prices.

postconditions.expression: float(result) == sum(float(price) for name, price in re.findall(r'([a-z]+)(\d+(\.\d{2})?)', s))
postconditions.description: The total price calculated from the output matches the sum of all prices in the input.
